lead_raw_text:
The structure of Zn2AgBiCl6 crystallizes in the cubic space group Fm-3m (No. 216), with a unit cell containing 40 atoms across four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ag and Bi each adopt octahedral environments with six Cl neighbors, while Zn also exhibits six Cl neighbors in an octahedral motif. These polyhedra connect through corner-sharing between Ag and Bi octahedra, and through both corner- and face-sharing between Zn octahedra and Ag or Bi octahedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 40 sites.
